Nil metadata is serialized as `metadata:null` despite the documented omission contract
The new response conversion assigns `v.Metadata` (a nil map when metadata is omitted) to the internal `Metadata interface{}` field. That interface then contains a typed nil map and is not empty for `omitempty`, so it is serialized as `"metadata":null`. The added test confirms this output, while the changed public documentation explicitly guarantees that a response without metadata contains only `data`.
Impact: Whenever a handler returns `resTypes.Response` without initializing `Metadata`, the observable JSON contains `metadata:null` instead of omitting the member as documented.
Fix: Make the internal metadata field `map[string]any` so `omitempty` recognizes a nil map, or only assign/include the metadata field when `v.Metadata` is non-nil. Update the test to expect the documented data-only response.
